reason: The README describes a DSH plugin primarily for delegating tasks to configurable subagents and monitoring their live activity through a multi-panel web viewer.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可按调用选择模型或提供商的子智能体委派工具，以及用于实时查看多个子智能体活动的多面板网页界面。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for delegating tasks to subagents with per-call model or provider selection and monitoring their live activity in a multi-panel web interface.

capabilities: selects a model and optionally a provider per call
supports foreground and background subagent execution
streams subagent reasoning, tool calls, and text in a web interface
displays subagent activity and sends in-interface notifications
